I give up. I believe the theorem as stated is false, so it can't be proved.

The structure `PreNecklaces` only requires some 4-element set of positions where `c i = 0`. That means at least 4 beads have colour 0, not exactly 4. Necklaces are colourings of 7 positions with 2 colours, taken up to the full dihedral group of order 14.

I counted the classes by the number of beads with colour 1. This is a hand count that I did not check in Lean.

| Beads with colour 1 | Distinct necklaces |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 3 |
| 3 | 4 |

That gives 1 + 1 + 3 + 4 = 9 necklaces, not 15. The count of 18 binary bracelets of length 7 is consistent with this. Even with the "exactly four red and three blue" reading, only the 4 classes with three beads of colour 1 would count.

I did not edit the file.
